subject: Request: temporary version hold for Sedona-Lite v2.1 (customer-impacting)
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@trucommerce.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: TruCommerce SRE <sre@trucommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration concerns with Sedona-Lite v2.1 - observed timeouts

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from our integration run this morning: when we hit a long-context billing query (input ~3.2k tokens) Sedona-Lite v2.1 starts returning incomplete JSON and occasionally times out at 6s, which breaks our pre-parse step. We validated the same prompt with v2.0 and it behaved normally.

This is blocking our UAT tomorrow. Can you escalate/confirm whether Redwood can pin our account to Sedona-Lite v2.0 (or a compatible fallback) while you investigate v2.1? We need the pin for at least 72 hours to complete regression tests.

Attached: a short capture of the request/response and a minimal repro script.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Senior Platform Engineer, TruCommerce
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@trucommerce.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration concerns with Sedona-Lite v2.1 - observed timeouts

Emily — thanks for the quick repro and the attachments. We're looking into this and I want to propose the following immediate steps: 

- Temporary account-level pin to Sedona-Lite v2.0 for TruCommerce for 72 hours (per your ask)
- Run a targeted regression suite (latency, token streaming, JSON completion) against your failing prompt set
- If we confirm a degradant in v2.1, open an urgent compatibility issue and schedule a rollback window or variant patch

Laura / Karthik — can you confirm feasibility of a 72-hour per-account pin for a paying customer (DC-9812)? If yes, I will coordinate with TruCommerce and our SREs. We need:
- who owns the pin toggle (Console config vs. infra flag)
- any audit/logging changes while pinned
- a fallback routing plan in case pinned nodes degrade on infra side

Emily — can you point to the exact requests you want included in the regression run (sample set or Drive link is fine)?

-Jordan

Jordan / Karthik — short answers:

- Pin feasibility: yes, we have an account-scoped version pin capability in Console for hosted customers. It can be applied immediately but must be actioned by infra (Karthik) if routing changes are required.
- Duration: Console supports arbitrary expiry; recommend 72 hrs as requested.
- Observability: audit log will record the pin event, but we should also add a per-account latency and error-rate metric to the dashboard for the duration.

Karthik — can you schedule a quick change window to:
1) apply the Console pin (low-risk)
2) patch routing fallback rules if any of the pinned fleet degrades

Monica — CS wants a brief note to TruCommerce explaining the plan and rollback criteria. Can you draft an email that includes: scope, duration, monitoring signals, and clear owner for reversion?

I'll also queue a regression job against the repro set once Emily posts it to the Drive link.

-Laura
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@trucommerce.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary version hold for Sedona-Lite v2.1 (customer-impacting)

All — actioning now: 

1) Applied account-level pin for TruCommerce -> Sedona-Lite v2.0, expiry set 2027-06-13T09:47:00-07:00 (72 hrs). Audit event: PIN_APPLIED by k_iyer.
2) Started rolling a lightweight regression run against the repro set (job INF-2345). Early telemetry: pinned calls show stable completions at 1.8–2.2s median for the sample; no JSON truncation so far.
3) Routing fallback: added a temporary rule to redirect to compatible pool if v2.0 nodes hit error rate > 2% for 5m. That rule is reversible and logged.

Monica — I left a note in the doc with the rollback criteria and links to dashboards. Monica / Jordan please send a short customer-facing email (cc'ed Emily) outlining the pin + monitoring plan.

Next steps (internal):
- Karthik: continue monitoring, escalate if pinned fleet shows issues
- Laura: run the extended regression overnight and flag any discrepant items
- Monica: draft and send a customer-facing note
- Jordan: coordinate post-mortem if v2.1 is confirmed regressing

Thanks — Karthik
